page.layout: One printed page, one text column at right with a narrow margin column at left holding side notes; running head at top; page number at top left of column; catchword and signature none.

main_text.p: P O S T R E M O Radicú, Foliorum, Florum, Fructuum & Seminum quaedam mirando quodam Sympathias mysterio respiciunt certa loca & membra in corpore humano calefaciendo, refrigerando, &c.Plantarum sympathia cum corpore humano.
1. Ex Radicibus calefaciunt Caput; Faeniculi, Paeoniae, &c.
Thoracem : Aristolochiae, Enulae, Spinae albae, Ireos.
Matricem: Endiviae, Lactucae, Nymphaeae, Portulacae, Sempervivi.
Junctúras ; Endiviae, Lactucae, Hyoscyami, Psyllii, Sepervivi, Solani, Myrti.
2. Ex Floribus calefaciunt Caput: Rorismarini, Prunellae, Chamomillae, Betonicae, Primulae veris, Lavendulae, Meliloti, Paeoniae, Salviae, Staechados, Tiliae.
Pectus : Betonicae, Junci odorati, Melissae, Scabiosae.
Cor ; Anthos, Borraginis, Buglossae, Melissae, Spicaenardi.

page.notes: Left margin note reads "Plantarum sympathia cum corpore humano" (running side title, three lines). Printed catchword absent. Several words in the Cor and Matricem lines are doubtful (e.g. "Becn albú" possibly "Becabunga"/"Beccabunga"; "Zeduariae" possibly "Zedoariae"; "Sepervivi" possibly "Sempervivi"; "Junctúras" possibly "Iuncturas"); no [?] markers were added because the scan is low resolution. Bottom "Epar." is a signature-like mark at foot right and is not transcribed as text.
